sources.title: Hyundai Australia – 2026 IONIQ 5 Specification Sheet (PDF)
sources.notes: Australian-market sheet. Used only for hardware shared with the Canadian car (84 kWh liquid-cooled lithium-ion pack, 697 V). Its Type 2 port and 10.5 kW onboard charger are Australian-spec and not used.

sources.title: Hyundai Canada – 2026 IONIQ 9 showroom page
sources.notes: States a 110.3 kWh battery (not saying gross or usable), 800V charging architecture, NACS port with AC and DC CCS adapters, Tesla Supercharger access, a standard heat pump, about 24 minutes 10–80% on a 350 kW charger, and an 'Essential RWD' base trim. The trim comparison table did not load.

sources.title: Hyundai Canada – 2026 KONA Electric showroom page
sources.notes: States a 64.8 kWh battery (not saying gross or usable), front-wheel drive, a heat pump (not saying standard or optional), and 10–80% in about 43 minutes on a Level 3 charger (>100 kW); its FAQ also says about 45 minutes, so the time is low confidence. Port type not stated.
